title: White matter pathways
description: We develop and validate diffusion MRI tractography to investigate white matter pathways and the organization of the living brain.
alt: Color-coded white matter pathways from the lab’s tractography research

title: Tissue microstructure
description: We connect MRI measurements with histology to study tissue organization in the brain and spinal cord.

title: White matter across the lifespan
description: We investigate how white matter develops and changes with age using diffusion MRI and longitudinal modeling.
alt: Projection tract illustration and age-related microstructural and macrostructural measurements

title: Software and validation
description: We share pipelines, quality assurance methods, datasets, and community challenges to support reproducible imaging research.

title: Spinal cord MRI
description: We develop spinal cord acquisition and processing methods that address motion, distortion, and signal variability.
alt: Spinal cord MRI and tractography visualization from the lab’s research page
